scientific_integrity: Infinite recurrence proved by an explicit finite-state subset construction and rational transfer elimination; direct finite input enumeration corroborates but is not the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact enumeration only for reflexive closed-neighborhood tolerances on finite simple paths; no proof for arbitrary graph classes or equivalence-based rough sets. A related historical path study was accessible only by abstract, leaving residual priority uncertainty.
title: A Tribonacci rough-pair census for closed-neighborhood tolerances on finite paths
